articles.summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust, Inc. (NYSE: AHT or the "Company") today announced that its advisor, Ashford Inc., has agreed to waive approximately $17 million of advisory fees that would otherwise be earned over the next six months and to purchase 2.5% of the Company's outstanding common stock in the open market each quarter, and that the Company has terminated its at-the-market equity offering program. The fee waiver and the share purchase agreement were approved by the independent members of the Company's Board of Directors. These actions are intended to strengthen the Company's liquidity and further align the interests of its advisor with those of its stockholders. "The independent directors approached these agreements with two goals: improve the Company's liquidity and put our advisor's capital alongside our stockholders'," said Amish Gupta, Vice Chairman and Lead Independent Director.
